resources.string: Keeping %1$d outstanding chats synchronized. Tap to open AgentLink.
A remote task needs your approval. Open AgentLink to review the details.
Background monitoring reached its time limit. Reopen AgentLink to synchronize; the remote task may still be running.
Monitoring stopped because bridge or tunnel access was rejected. Reopen AgentLink to refresh access and reconnect.
Some remote events are no longer available. Reopen AgentLink to recover chat history; the remote task was not restarted.
Connection interrupted. Background monitoring is reconnecting; the remote task may still be running.
Android could not start background monitoring. Keep AgentLink open or reopen it to synchronize outstanding tasks.
Background monitoring could not save or load chat state. Reopen AgentLink to synchronize safely.
The paired machine is unavailable. Reopen AgentLink to check its pairing and synchronize.
The remote task completed. Open AgentLink to read the response.
The remote task failed. Open AgentLink to review the error.
